correctness.rationale: Direct substitution yields the exact positive-root quadratic in rescaled radial coordinates. Discriminant factors into (h-d)(h+d) and identifies the entire interval; Jacobian X gives the exact area formula. A uniform inequality bounds replacing h sqrt(h²-d²) by h² at O(a²), endpoints are O(a) from 0 and 3/2, and rational polynomial integration gives coefficients 81/560 and -81/280. Uniform convergence of outer branch and inner-branch product X+X-=a²z² establishes Hausdorff loop and extrema. Exact rational checker independently evaluates coefficients and numerical quadrature checks representative positive parameters; no finite test substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Earlier work identifies the dynamical heteroclinic escape of this fundamental degree-four quadratic limit cycle but does not quantify its Euclidean geometry. The natural whole-cycle enclosed area diverges at an unexpectedly high fourth power with a nonzero next-order term; a complete affine rescaling supplies the limiting shape and both coordinate escape constants. These sharpen a natural singular degeneration throughout the established 0<a<3/13 family rather than choosing an arbitrary slice or mere coordinate normalization.
